name: recent_answers
description: What the learner typed or said lately in the app (the last 7 days, at most 500 answers), newest first: each card a review counted, where in the app (the review, the grammar book, a building's words run, a challenge, I spy, the car), with its exercise (how it was asked, what was typed or heard, what was expected, the verdict, the grading hint, the quality it gave the card; nothing typed where there is nothing to type, as the car's ✓/✗), the forms of words asked (their slot and grammar page), and a dialog's word turns; "📋 looked up …": the cheat sheet was open during it (the grammar pages of the cards opened). Use it when Jan says a card or an answer was marked wrong but the message has no about_exercise: look the card up (card_id, its id in spaced-repetition.json) or search a word (text, in what was asked, typed or expected; diacritics optional: "zivjo" finds "živjo"). The lani-fix skill uses it. looked_up: true lists what Jan answered with the cheat sheet open, what they look up.

card_id.description: a review card id, e.g. vocab_kurim

text.description: a word in what was asked, typed or expected, e.g. kurim

wrong_only.description: only answers marked wrong or almost (by the verdict: a right answer whose quality hints lowered is not wrong)

looked_up.description: only answers given with the cheat sheet open (📋 Plonk listek): what Jan looked up

language.description: another language's deck ("it"); "" for the home language only

limit.description: at most this many (default 20, at most 100)
